description:
Product Creation and Industrialization (PC&I) brings together Ford’s vehicle, electric, digital and design teams with our global manufacturing system. Working as one end-to-end organization, we turn ideas into high-quality vehicles, software and experiences across gas, hybrid and electric, designed around what customers need.
 If good is just never good enough for you, Ford Quality shares your passion for striving for perfection. We’re responsible for driving the continuous improvement efforts that enable Ford to deliver the highest quality products and services. Help us drive operational excellence through such innovative, proprietary initiatives as our Global Product Development System, Quality Operating System and New Model Launch. Work cross-functionally and closely with integrated teams in Manufacturing, Product Development, Purchasing, Marketing, Sales and Service.

 In this position... 
Help Ford catch vehicle issues before customers do. As a Connected Vehicle Quality Engineer you'll use connected vehicle data and analytics to spot emerging diagnostic trends. You'll also lead cross-functional teams to resolve issues early, cutting costs and improving the ownership experience.
 Join Ford Motor Company as a Connected Vehicle Quality Engineer for Early Warning and Detection, where you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality of customer vehicles. Based in Dearborn, Michigan, this hybrid role (4 days on-site, 1 day remote) leverages connected vehicle data and advanced analytics to identify Diagnostic Trouble Codes across critical subsystems, including Electronic Hardware Systems, Body Hardware and Software Controls Systems. You will lead cross-functional teams to resolve issues before they reach the customer, driving enterprise-wide initiatives to reduce costs and elevate the ownership experience.
 As Ford continues its transformation into a digital-first automotive leader, the ability to monitor vehicle health through connected data is paramount. We are seeking a proactive Engineer/Project Manager to join our Digital Systems Quality organization, specifically focused on the high-stakes environment of customer vehicles. Our organization thrives on a culture of proactive discovery and rapid issue resolution.
 What you'll do... 
 You will serve as a primary early warning system for the enterprise, transforming large-scale connected vehicle data into actionable insights to identify and address emerging Diagnostic Trouble Code (DTC) trends. 
 You will focus on the industry’s most complex domains — from the user experience of Electronic Hardware Systems, Body Hardware and Software Controls Systems. 
 Working primarily on-site at our Dearborn campus, you will lead cross-functional investigations, bringing together experts from Engineering, Manufacturing, and Service to solve complex problems at speed.
 Extract and analyze information from connected vehicle data streams to identify early-stage DTCs and performance anomalies for post launch customer vehicles.
 Lead specialized investigations into Electronic Hardware Systems, Body Hardware and Software Controls Systems performance, using domain knowledge to differentiate between software interactions, hardware failures, and calibration issues.
 Manage cross-functional quality investigations, ensuring that emerging issues are tracked, root-caused, and resolved by the proper Product Development teams.
 Strategic Reporting: Synthesize complex data into clear insights for leadership, focusing on the impact to enterprise Cost and Quality metrics.
 Drive the development of automated detection tools and analytics dashboards to improve the "speed to detection" for vehicle health issues.
 
 You'll have... 
 Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Computer, Systems, or Data Engineering or similar technical discipline.
 5+ years of experience in engineering, product quality, reliability, connected products, systems engineering, diagnostics, technical operations, or data analytics.
 3+ years of proven experience working with Big Data tools (e.g., SQL, GCP BigQuery, GCP DML, or PowerBI) to drive
 2+ years of experience using analytics, visualization, cloud-data, or reporting tools to identify trends and support business or technical decisions.
 Experience investigating issues across complex hardware-and-software products or systems.
 Experience using telemetry, event logs, system alerts, fault codes, or operational data to identify and investigate emerging product-performance concerns.
 Experience applying structured problem-solving or root-cause methods to resolve technical, quality, reliability, or customer-impact issues.
 Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and driving alignment without direct authority.
 Ability to communicate technical findings, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  
 Even better, you may have... 
 Masters’s degree in Electrical, Computer, Systems, or Data Engineering preferred
 Automotive, connected-vehicle, telematics, vehicle quality, warranty, service engineering, or field-quality experience.
 Experience with vehicle DTCs, vehicle diagnostic strategies, CAN, Automotive Ethernet, ECUs, body electronics, embedded software, or calibration.
 Experience using connected-vehicle or fleet data to detect early product-quality or customer-impact trends.
 Experience with Ford processes, Ford data environments, Ford diagnostic tools, or Ford quality methodologies.
 Familiarity with 8D, 3-Legged 5-Why, FMEA, or similar formal root-cause and corrective-action methods.
 Experience with BigQuery, GCP DML, Power BI, automated detection tools, dashboards, or anomaly-detection workflows.
 
You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!
 As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including: 
 • Immediate medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage 
 • Paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more 
 • Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments and more 
 • Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases 
 • Tuition assistance 
 • Established and active employee resource groups 
 • Paid time off for individual and team community service 
 • Generous vacation time, sick/personal time, and paid holidays, including between Christmas Eve and New Year’s Day 
 This position is a salary grade 6 -7 and ranges from $85,400-$150,250.00.  Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value.
 
 Internal applicants: moving into this role may result in an adjustment to your current compensation based on the posted pay range for this role, taking into consideration your qualifications and other relevant factors.

For more information on salary and benefits, click here: https://fordcareers.co/GSR 
 Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
 Candidates for positions with Ford Motor Company must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire.
 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status or protected veteran status. In the United States, if you need a reasonable accommodation for the online application process due to a disability, please call 1-888-336-0660.
 This position is hybrid with a requirement to be onsite four or more days per week. #LI-Hybrid     #LI-KD1
